arguments.sql: SELECT printf('%05d', ml.zip) AS zip_code, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions t JOIN merchant_locations ml ON t.merchant_location_id = ml.id WHERE ml.state = 'MA' AND ml.zip IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ml.zip ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, ml.zip ASC LIMIT 1
arguments.explanation: Finds the Massachusetts ZIP code with the most transactions, returned as a zero-padded five-digit text value.
assumptions: Counts all transactions regardless of whether they have a fraud label.
Location is taken from transactions.merchant_location_id joined to merchant_locations, with state = 'MA'.
Transactions at locations with a NULL ZIP are excluded.
ZIP is stored as an integer, so it is zero-padded to five digits (e.g. 2139 becomes '02139').
Ties would go to the lower ZIP code.
